limitations: All twelve poses are present in three rows, but columns are not uniform. Use explicit sourceRects, not equal grid slicing.

Some rectangles overlap. Clean display needs connected-component isolation: flood-fill from each frame alphaComponentSeed with four-neighbor connectivity and keep only alpha >24. Cache the isolated RGBA pixels on a per-frame canvas.
Semi-transparent fringe with alpha<=24 connects nearby poses; discarding this near-invisible fringe produces exactly twelve disconnected silhouettes.
Pose scales and feet baselines vary slightly. Use pivots and the fighter-wide standingHeight for rendering.

ben.renderingNote: Use the same scale = desiredStandingHeight / standingHeight for every frame. Draw each cached isolated frame at (fighterX - pivot[0]*scale, groundY - jumpOffset - pivot[1]*scale). Mirror the frame canvas horizontally around fighterX when facing left.
